Tomato poda
By Ahimanikya Satapathy

Confirm local access, transport and availability before travel.
Oriyarasoi roasts until the tomato’s skin blackens, then rests, peels and chops it into chunks. Mustard oil and aromatics follow. The author uses knife and spoon rather than hand-mashing.
